text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The action actor made it through the 
audition by incorporating Umamusume action 
into his acting. However, the strain took 
its toll and he had to be rushed to the 
hospital.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The diagnosis was that continuing like 
this would affect her acting career. Even 
so, she refused to back down from taking 
on the stunts herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The actor was inspired by Biko Pegasus's 
courage to fight even at great cost. He 
declared that he, too, would face his 
challenges with full resolve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Worried, Biko Pegasus opposed the 
challenge. However, her Trainer reminded 
her that a hero is someone who always 
takes on challenges.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Convinced, Biko Pegasus promised to 
support the actor's endeavor. As a result, 
the actor passed the audition with flying 
colors!
